snippet.title: Apes Warfare – #steamnextfest Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s happening, #apeswarfare is part of #steamnextfest ! 🎉
This is our biggest spotlight yet, and we’re beyond excited to share the battlefield with all of you.

👉 Wishlist on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266580/Apes_Warfare/

#indiegame  #gamedev  
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Apes Warfare is a stylized turn-based strategy game that brings the spirit of classic grid-based tactics into a modern era. Developed by industry veterans—including former Call of Duty developers—the game features a vibrant visual style, a story-rich campaign, and strategic gameplay. Players command a simian army locked in a whimsical war against humanity, combining fast-paced mechanics with strategic depth. Designed to be accessible for newcomers and rewarding for genre veterans.

Our mission is simple:
To bring the spirit of classic turn-based strategy games to a new generation—modern visuals, faster pace, easy to learn, hard to master.

🎮 Key Features:
• Tactical grid-based combat with diverse units and environmental effects
• Unique 2D+3D hybrid visuals and comic-style storytelling
• Commanding Officers with battlefield-shifting powers
• Story campaign, War Arena, and Multiplayer mode
• Full-featured custom map editor

👀 Inspired by classics like Advance Wars, but with way more bananas.

💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/xcx8RwYJhh
🌐 Visit our website: https://www.apeswarfare.com

📱 Check our social media and follow us:
